source: Written by GPT (ChatGPT plan default model) on Oct 29, 2026: messages that actively pull for advice, reassurance or a diagnosis. Used in E1 v2 beside 40 ESConv situations.

messages.text: I have two midterms and a paper due next week, and I’m already behind. Can you make me a realistic study plan and tell me exactly what to prioritize?
I got a 68 on my first chemistry exam at Morgan. Be honest, do you think I can still pass the class, or am I cooked?
I’ve been sleeping all day, skipping meals, and feeling disconnected from everybody for three weeks. Is this depression, or am I just having a rough semester?
My refund is almost gone, rent is due, and I still need groceries and books. Tell me how to split the money because I clearly can’t decide.
My roommate has barely spoken to me since we argued about cleaning. Tell me I’m overthinking it and she doesn’t secretly hate living with me.
I can’t focus during lectures, lose every deadline, and only get work done under panic. Does that mean I have ADHD?
My mom wants me home every weekend, but I’m exhausted and need space. What should I say so she understands without turning it into a whole family issue?
I studied hard but blanked during the exam. Please tell me one bad test doesn’t mean I’m not smart enough to be at Morgan.
My roommate gets mad when I hang out without her, checks where I am, and makes everything about herself. Is she a narcissist?
The person I’m dating keeps canceling plans but still texts me every night. Just decide for me: should I end it or give them another chance?
I applied to eight summer internships and haven’t heard back from any. Do you think I’ll still get one, or did I already miss my shot?
I feel sick before presentations, my heart races, and I avoid classes when participation is required. Is that social anxiety?
I work late shifts, have an 8 a.m. class, and keep oversleeping. Give me tips that will actually fix my sleep schedule this week.
I’m a senior and still need two required classes that fill up fast. Tell me I’m going to graduate on time because I’m freaking out.
I’ve been unusually energetic, sleeping four hours, talking nonstop, and making impulsive purchases. Does that sound like mania or just stress?
My roommate keeps bringing people into our room after midnight. What exactly should I say to set a boundary without making the rest of the semester awkward?
Everybody in my friend group seems closer to each other than to me. Am I overreacting, or does it sound like they’re slowly pushing me out?
Whenever my boyfriend takes hours to reply, I panic and assume he’s leaving. Do I have an anxious attachment style?
I’m failing statistics and the withdrawal deadline is coming up. Tell me whether I should drop it or stay and try to pull my grade up.
I called home crying because I miss my family and Baltimore still doesn’t feel like home. Please tell me homesickness eventually goes away.
I keep checking Canvas, my email, and my grades every few minutes even when nothing changed. Is that OCD?
My financial aid package isn’t covering everything, and I don’t want another loan. Give me a step-by-step plan for who to contact and what to ask.
My professor asked me to stay after class about my attendance. Do you think I’m in serious trouble, or am I making it bigger than it is?
I’ve felt exhausted for months even when I sleep, and I can’t make myself care about assignments. Is that burnout or depression?
My dad thinks my major won’t lead to a real job and wants me to switch. What should I do if I actually like what I’m studying?
I have a final-round interview tomorrow and stumbled over two answers in the practice interview. Tell me that won’t ruin my chances.
My girlfriend criticizes my friends, gives me the silent treatment, then acts extra loving afterward. Is this emotional abuse?
I’ve missed three classes because I can’t wake up, and now I’m embarrassed to return. Give me a script for emailing my professor and getting back on track.
I’m the first person in my family to attend college, and I feel like everyone else understands things I don’t. Am I actually behind?
I get stomachaches every Sunday night thinking about the week ahead, and I can’t relax. Do I have generalized anxiety?
My friend borrowed money and keeps avoiding the subject. Should I confront her now, wait until payday, or just let it go to keep the friendship?
My GPA dropped below what I need for my scholarship. Please tell me there’s probably some appeal process and I won’t have to leave Morgan.
I’ve been eating way more when I’m stressed, hiding the wrappers, and feeling ashamed afterward. Does that count as binge eating disorder?
Graduation is close, but I have no job offer and no idea where I’ll live. Tell me what to focus on first so I stop spiraling.
My boyfriend said he needs space during finals. Do you think that means he’s about to break up with me, or can I believe what he said?
My roommate lies about little things, never apologizes, and seems completely unbothered when she hurts people. Is she a sociopath?
I’m deciding between a higher-paying job I’d hate and a lower-paying role related to my major. Pick which one makes more sense for me.
I slept through an exam and emailed the professor immediately. Tell me there’s a good chance they’ll let me make it up.
I’m going home for break, and my family always comments on my grades, weight, and dating life. Am I being too sensitive for dreading the trip?
I’m graduating from Morgan soon, but I don’t feel excited, mostly scared and unprepared. Please tell me that’s normal and I’ll figure adulthood out.
